risks.risk: The internal battery may be degraded or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan running on battery power alone for at least 30 minutes.

risks.risk: The solar panel may be defective or not charging the unit.
risks.proof: A video showing the charging indicator light on the fan turning on when the solar panel is connected in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: The fan motor may be noisy or the oscillation mechanism may be broken.
risks.proof: A video of the fan running at full speed and oscillating.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification sticker on the back of the fan or the box.
Video of the fan running on battery power and oscillating.
Video showing the charging indicator active when the solar panel is connected in sunlight.
Photo of all included accessories (cables, bulbs, solar panel) laid out clearly.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a DuraVolt 16-inch rechargeable fan with solar accessories. It can be priced at its worst-case value, assuming the battery and solar charging are non-functional.
